title: Multi-release corpus group 1 check eight original upgrade pairs
description: Repeat eight original native claims at the selected JDK release using both exact recorded runtime graphs, with the original operator entry and the same per-case check deadline. Full rerun includes compiler and resolver failures. Cases: compsuite-i-38, ea-async-27, whatjdk-12, incremental-analysis-28, compsuite-i-1, compsuite-i-70, compsuite-i-10, compsuite-i-85.
expected: Every case has a fresh report with its real outcome and exact artifact hashes when compilation succeeded.
